In a live broadcast from Washington, D.C., on Veterans Day, L3Harris President and CEO Sam Mehta joined Morgan Brennan on CNBC’s “Morning Call.” Mehta discussed the company’s focus on delivering capabilities to U.S. and allied warfighters at the speed and scale needed to counter near-peer adversaries, its evolution to become a prime contractor in the space domain and the increasing international demand for L3Harris solutions.
